summary.zh: 组织知识、授权与本体版本的隔离边界。
summary.en: Isolation boundary for organizational knowledge, grants, and ontology revisions.

summary.zh: 定义允许进入本体构建流程的资料范围与约束。
summary.en: Defines which material may enter ontology construction and under which constraints.

summary.zh: 被授权纳入语义构建的资料资产。
summary.en: An information asset authorized for semantic construction.

summary.zh: 资料在某一时间点的不可变版本。
summary.en: An immutable version of an admitted information asset.

summary.zh: 限制资料发现、读取与处理范围的授权事实。
summary.en: Authorization facts limiting source discovery, reads, and processing.

summary.zh: 从已准入公开文档中提取并验证的证据。
summary.en: Evidence extracted and verified from admitted public documents.

summary.zh: 把语义结论追溯到公开文档的稳定引用。
summary.en: A stable reference connecting semantic conclusions to public documentation.

summary.zh: 由证据支持、可被验证的语义陈述。
summary.en: A verifiable semantic statement supported by evidence.

summary.zh: 跨文档统一标识的业务或技术概念。
summary.en: A business or technical concept normalized across documents.

summary.zh: Agent 生成、等待政策与证据验证的候选语义。
summary.en: Candidate semantics proposed by an Agent pending policy and evidence checks.

summary.zh: 通过验证并编译的不可变本体修订。
summary.en: An immutable ontology revision produced by validation and compilation.

summary.zh: 由已接纳本体修订编译出的 schema-v3 认知包草案。
summary.en: A schema-v3 cognitive-package draft compiled from an admitted ontology revision.

summary.zh: A3S Use 安装、锁定并原子发布的认知包生命周期单元。
summary.en: The cognitive-package lifecycle unit installed, locked, and atomically published by A3S Use.

summary.zh: 包含概念、关系和引用的 Agent 知识表面。
summary.en: The Agent knowledge surface containing concepts, relationships, and citations.

summary.zh: 说明 Agent 如何使用认知包及其知识边界。
summary.en: Instructions describing how an Agent uses the package and its knowledge boundaries.

summary.zh: 绑定身份、范围、预算与工具的受治理 Agent 会话。
summary.en: A governed Agent session bound to identity, scope, budget, and tools.

summary.zh: 宿主观察到的精确认知包 generation 与就绪表面集合。
summary.en: The exact package generation and ready surfaces observed by an Agent host.

summary.zh: 持续发现覆盖、变化与缺口，并规划受限学习工作。
summary.en: Continuously discovers coverage, change, and gaps, then plans bounded learning work.

summary.zh: 从资料版本到本体激活的可恢复处理过程。
summary.en: Recoverable processing from an asset version to ontology activation.

summary.zh: 将已验证语义编译为本体修订与认知包草案。
summary.en: Compiles verified semantics into an ontology revision and cognitive-package draft.

summary.zh: 来自认知包使用结果、等待资格验证的学习信号。
summary.en: A learning signal from cognitive-package usage awaiting qualification.

summary.zh: 对本体质量、认知包效果与版本回归进行可复现评估。
summary.en: Reproducible evaluation of ontology quality, package outcomes, and revision regressions.

summary.zh: 表达证据与认知包知识可被依赖的程度。
summary.en: Expresses how strongly evidence or packaged knowledge may be relied upon.

summary.zh: 约束资料准入、语义验证、认知包生成和保留策略。
summary.en: Constrains source admission, semantic validation, package generation, and retention.

summary.zh: 解析认知包依赖，锁定精确 generation，并原子发布 OKF 与 Skill 等表面。
summary.en: Resolves cognitive-package dependencies, locks an exact generation, and atomically publishes surfaces such as OKF and Skill.

summary.zh: 承载 Agent，并消费 A3S Use 发布的精确认知包 generation。
summary.en: Hosts Agents and consumes the exact cognitive-package generation published by A3S Use.

summary.zh: 保存探索、摄取、编译与评估的持久工作流历史。
summary.en: Owns durable workflow history for exploration, ingestion, compilation, and evaluation.

summary.zh: 部署和协调工作负载，不拥有组织知识权威。
summary.en: Deploys and coordinates workloads without owning organizational knowledge authority.

summary.zh: 允许进入公开演示图谱的产品文档。
summary.en: A product document admitted to the public demonstration graph.

summary.zh: 允许进入公开演示图谱的产品文档。
summary.en: A product document admitted to the public demonstration graph.

summary.en: A product document admitted to the public demonstration graph.

summary.en: A product document admitted to the public demonstration graph.

label.zh: 包含 OKF 知识表面
包含 Skill 认知说明

learned.zh: 识别 Workspace、KnowledgeScope 与资料授权边界。
learned.en: Identified Workspace, KnowledgeScope, and source authorization boundaries.

semantics.zh: 新增 2 个实体候选，关联 5 条定义证据。
semantics.en: Proposed 2 entities and linked 5 definition evidence items.

title.zh: 理解 Workspace / KnowledgeScope 边界

learned.zh: Workspace 是权威隔离边界，KnowledgeScope 是本体构建的资料准入边界。
learned.en: Workspace is the authority boundary; KnowledgeScope controls which material enters ontology construction.

semantics.zh: 区分组织权威与一次语义构建所允许读取的资料范围。
semantics.en: Separated organizational authority from the material admitted to one semantic build.

learned.zh: 任何 KnowledgeScope 必须落在显式授权的 Workspace 内。
learned.en: Every KnowledgeScope must remain within an explicitly authorized Workspace.

semantics.zh: Workspace → KnowledgeScope 形成可审核的资料授权链。
semantics.en: Workspace → KnowledgeScope now forms an auditable source-authorization chain.

learned.zh: 已接纳的本体修订可以编译为 A3S Use schema-v3 认知包草案。
learned.en: An admitted ontology revision can be compiled into an A3S Use schema-v3 cognitive-package draft.

semantics.en: Connected KnowledgeRevision, CognitivePackageDraft, OKF, and Skill.

learned.zh: 进入 OKF 的概念和关系必须保留公开引用与信任等级。
learned.en: Concepts and relationships entering OKF must retain public citations and trust levels.

semantics.zh: 2 条认知包知识路径通过公开证据一致性检查。
semantics.en: Two package-knowledge paths passed public-evidence consistency checks.

learned.zh: 只有已验证提案进入不可变知识修订。
learned.en: Only validated proposals enter an immutable knowledge revision.

semantics.zh: Revision 18 被锁定，并生成认知包草案；尚未由 A3S Use 安装。
semantics.en: Revision 18 was locked and a cognitive-package draft was generated; A3S Use has not installed it.

learned.zh: Agent 只能使用 A3S Use 已安装、已锁定并发布的精确 package generation。
learned.en: Agents can use only an exact package generation that A3S Use has installed, locked, and published.

semantics.zh: 已规划 OKF 与 Skill 表面；当前演示仍是未安装、未锁定的协议预览。
semantics.en: OKF and Skill surfaces are planned; this demo remains an uninstalled, unlocked protocol preview.

learned.zh: Agent 使用认知包后的结果只能产生待验证信号，不能直接修改正式本体。
learned.en: Outcomes from cognitive-package use can create only a signal awaiting validation; they cannot mutate the canonical ontology.

semantics.zh: 学习信号进入评估，并可触发下一轮文档探索。
semantics.en: The learning signal enters evaluation and may trigger another document exploration run.

summary.zh: 公开文档已编译为 Revision 18 与 schema-v3 草案；流程正在等待 A3S Use 校验、锁定和发布。
summary.en: Public documents compiled into Revision 18 and a schema-v3 draft; the run is waiting for A3S Use validation, locking, and publication.

summary.zh: KnowledgeScope 只允许六份公开产品文档及其明确版本进入本次构建。
summary.en: The KnowledgeScope admits only six public product documents and their declared versions into this build.

detail.zh: 所有资料都命中显式白名单；构建过程不能自行扩大范围。
detail.en: Every document matched the explicit allow-list; the build cannot expand its own scope.

notices.zh: 公开演示不会读取源码或仓库位置。
notices.en: The public demo never reads source bodies or repository locations.

summary.zh: 固定的 Parser generation 生成类型化证据、摘要与可追溯公开引用。
summary.en: A pinned Parser generation produced typed evidence, digests, and traceable public citations.

value.zh: 2 项不受支持的附件声明

detail.zh: 每项被接纳证据都绑定生产者 generation、资料摘要与公开引用。
detail.en: Every admitted evidence item binds its producer generation, document digest, and public citation.

notices.zh: 文档内容被当作不可信资料，不会改变任务权限。
notices.en: Document content is treated as untrusted data and cannot change task authority.

summary.zh: 候选概念、关系和边界声明先经过确定性校验，再按风险策略决定是否需要人工复核。
summary.en: Candidate concepts, relations, and boundary claims passed deterministic checks before risk policy decided on human review.

value.zh: 1 项 · Agent 不回退图谱

detail.zh: 被接受语义均可追溯到已准入证据；拒绝项不会进入修订。
detail.en: Every accepted semantic item reaches admitted evidence; rejected items cannot enter the revision.

notices.zh: 模型输出始终是提案，不是正式知识。
notices.en: Model output remains a proposal, never accepted knowledge.

summary.zh: 已接受提案被编译成不可变 Revision 18，并以 compare-and-swap 激活。
summary.en: Accepted proposals compiled into immutable Revision 18 and activated through compare-and-swap.

detail.zh: 激活成功前旧修订保持有效；并发写入不能产生两个 active head。
detail.en: The previous revision stays valid until activation succeeds; concurrent writes cannot create two active heads.

notices.zh: 3D 图谱是 Revision 18 的人类审阅投影。
notices.en: The 3D graph is a human-review projection of Revision 18.

summary.zh: schema-v3 草案已生成；安装、依赖解析、锁定与发布仍在等待 A3S Use 的权威回执。
summary.en: The schema-v3 draft exists; installation, dependency resolution, locking, and publication still await authoritative A3S Use receipts.

value.zh: OKF 预览 · Skill 计划

detail.zh: Agentic Ontology 不能伪造安装或发布状态；没有 A3S Use 回执就保持未发布。
detail.en: Agentic Ontology cannot synthesize install or publication state; without an A3S Use receipt it remains unpublished.

notices.zh: 当前右侧面板展示的是草案，不是可供 Agent 使用的 generation。
notices.en: The right panel shows a draft, not a generation an Agent can consume.

summary.zh: 任务必须绑定已发布的精确 generation；当前没有可用 generation，因此会话明确失败且不回退读取图谱。
summary.en: The task must bind an exact published generation; none exists, so session opening fails explicitly and never falls back to the graph.

detail.zh: 缺少 generation 或锁定摘要时，A3S Code 不会创建 Agent 会话。
detail.en: A3S Code does not create an Agent session without a generation and lock digest.

notices.zh: 评估结果只能形成下一轮学习信号，不能直接修改 Revision 18。
notices.en: Evaluation results can only form a future learning signal; they cannot mutate Revision 18.

summary.zh: 概念、关系与公开引用。
summary.en: Concepts, relationships, and public citations.

summary.zh: Agent 使用这套知识时应遵循的说明与边界。
summary.en: Instructions and boundaries for Agents using this knowledge.
